card.name: Good in 'consistent with good patient management'
card.fires_on: The word 'good' in the antidepressant warning sentence about writing prescriptions for the smallest quantity consistent with good patient management.

modes.label: Smallest quantity wording
modes.description: The word 'good' right after 'consistent with' in the prescription-quantity advice that follows the line on daily observation by families and caregivers.

card.plain: It fires on the word 'good' in the standard antidepressant warning line about prescribing the smallest quantity consistent with good patient management.
